# Bundled libraries

EPUB.js 0.3.93, futurepress/epub.js. Official npm registry archive, installed with npm pack --ignore-scripts; distribution epub.min.js copied without alteration. License: epubjs-LICENSE.txt. Source: https://github.com/futurepress/epub.js

JSZip 3.10.2, Stuk/jszip. Official npm registry archive, installed with npm pack --ignore-scripts; distribution jszip.min.js copied without alteration. License: jszip-LICENSE.txt. Source: https://github.com/Stuk/jszip

The reader loads these local files and uses no CDN.
